title: Write the procedure that picks an API
heading: The Procedure, in Order
cases: a problem whose decisions are vehicles' routes goes to the routing library
a pure assignment or flow goes to the graph solvers and a pure knapsack to the knapsack solver
a general model with continuous amounts, or one whose caller wants dual prices, goes to MathOpt
an all-integer general model with intervals or dense logic goes to CP-SAT
an all-integer general model with neither intervals nor dense logic goes to MathOpt
an assignment or knapsack with one rule its solver cannot take is decided as a general model
a route problem with extra rules still goes to the routing library
a model with if-then rules and continuous amounts goes to MathOpt, since CP-SAT would round the amounts
